mapper.sql: pay26_tax_calc_table_id AS tax_calc_table_id, pay26_start_date AS start_date, pay26_from_amt AS from_amt, pay26_to_amt AS to_amt, pay26_basic_tax AS basic_tax, pay26_rate AS rate, pay26_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT pay26_tax_calc_table_id AS id, pay26_start_date AS start_date FROM (SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pay26_start_date) AS rn FROM pay26_tax_calc_table) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY pay26_start_date DESC
SELECT FROM pay26_tax_calc_table WHERE pay26_start_date = #{startDate} ORDER BY pay26_from_amt
SELECT FROM pay26_tax_calc_table WHERE pay26_start_date = (SELECT max(pay26_start_date) FROM pay26_tax_calc_table WHERE pay26_start_date <= #{startDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay26_tax_calc_table ( pay26_tax_calc_table_id, pay26_start_date, pay26_from_amt, pay26_to_amt , pay26_basic_tax, pay26_rate, pay26_note) VALUES ( #{id}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.fromAmt}, #{row.toAmt} , #{row.basicTax}, #{row.rate}, #{row.note})
mapper.update: UPDATE pay26_tax_calc_table SET pay26_from_amt = #{req.fromAmt}, pay26_to_amt = #{req.toAmt}, pay26_basic_tax = #{req.basicTax}, pay26_rate = #{req.rate}, pay26_note = #{req.note} WHERE pay26_tax_calc_table_id = #{req.taxCalcTableId}
